summary: Frontend-only native launcher icon regression validated from source config and runtime UI. Expo public config, v4 assets, and quality gates pass; no active old icon/splash/favicon references found.
action_items: Generate a NEW Android APK/AAB from this source and install it on device to verify launcher icon replacement (old installed APK cannot prove fix).
If old Emergent icon still appears after new install, uninstall previous app first and re-install latest build with versionCode 4.
critical_code_review_comments: npx expo config --type public --json confirms icon fields: icon/ios.icon/android.icon -> ./assets/images/racontelle-care-icon-v4.png.
android.adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage -> ./assets/images/racontelle-care-adaptive-v4.png and backgroundColor -> #FFFFFF; version=1.0.3 and android.versionCode=4 are correct.
No active app.json references to legacy names icon.png/adaptive-icon.png/splash-image.png/favicon.png; only bundleIdentifier contains 'emergent' string, unrelated to launcher icon asset selection.

Asset checks: racontelle-care-icon-v4.png is 1024x1024 with alpha 255 everywhere; adaptive-v4 is 1024x1024 with alpha 0..255 and visible centered monogram inside Android safe area; visual inspection shows no Emergent logo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested local checks passed: Expo Doctor 20/20, yarn lint, tsc --noEmit, expo export web, mobile web preview auth/home logos visible. Remaining verification is native launcher icon on freshly built and installed Android artifact.
rca_of_issue: Root cause remains consistent with stale native artifact behavior: launcher icon on installed APK is baked at build time. Even with corrected source config, existing installed APK keeps old icon until a new build (versionCode 4) is generated and installed.
